app.title: BREACH
onboard.role: You are a hacker. Break through a layered system one layer at a time and reach the core.
onboard.rule1: Each layer has a required access. Play one tool that clears it.
onboard.rule2: Every tool raises trace. At 100 you are caught.
onboard.hard: Stronger tools are louder. Quiet tools fall short, and whatever you fall short by also becomes trace. Both sides cost you — the whole game is which tool goes on which layer.
onboard.slack: Slack — access above the requirement is banked and covers shortfalls on later layers.
onboard.resist: Resistance — repeating the same approach teaches the system. Mix it up.
onboard.warn: Warning — the system always announces a counter one layer ahead.
run.pickTool: Pick a tool — it is consumed
counterHint.seal: On entering the next layer your best tool is sealed. Spend it now.
counterHint.priv_reset: Your privilege drops to 0 next layer. Spend it now.
counterHint.req_up: The next layer's requirement rises. Bank some slack.
counterHint.trace_boost: Trace jumps the moment you enter the next layer.
layerDesc.network: Easy to breach but traffic lingers — noise counts for more.
layerDesc.core: Clear this and the breach succeeds.
deck.targetSub: Each target demands different abilities. Build to match.
deck.avgNoise: Avg noise {n} — louder is stronger but trace climbs faster
result.scoreHint: Quieter breaches and unspent tools score higher.
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirmBody: Your deck, unlocks and records will all be gone. This cannot be undone.
